description: a unit square centred at the origin with its corners rounded at R 0.15, extruded 8.462 along z from z = −4.231, split by a plane through the origin tilted 36° from z, and the cap's rim filleted at r 0.05: four leaning junctions, each walked stripe's surface ended at the shared ball. Found by split_prop's a_side_is_an_operand_of_every_operation (plans/three-edge-run-vertex step 3)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE splits the corner blend at two of the leaning junctions, by the corners (0.35, −0.5) and (−0.5, 0.35), into two faces each, a sliver of 0.0038 beside the corner's blend: one more face, three more edges and two more vertices each (28/46/20/20); Arris keeps one blend face per chain edge, as Open CASCADE does at the other two corners
analytic.measure_differs: Open CASCADE's corner blends of the tilted plane against the corner cylinders miss the rolling ball, as on blend/rounded-block-oblique-top-fillet (a walked blend with no closed form), and its volume sits off Arris's. A second kernel's blend faces lie on the ball, and its volume, area, centroid and inertia, in second_oracle.json, are the fixture's measures; the volume, area and inertia are held to 1e-8, not 1e-9, because that kernel's read of the unblended operand is itself 6.6e-9 off Open CASCADE's (ADR-0073)
